Signing a PSBT with the command line

This guide shows how to sign a partially signed transaction with bitcoin-cli. You need a wallet that holds the keys for at least one input.

Process the PSBT

Call walletProcessPsbt with the base64 string. The wallet fills in what it knows and signs every input it can.

bitcoin-cli -rpcwallet=cold walletprocesspsbt "cHNidP8BAH0CAAAAAb..."

The result contains the updated PSBT and a flag that says whether it is complete.

Finalize and broadcast

When every signer is done, finalize the PSBT and extract the raw transaction. Then broadcast it with sendrawtransaction.
